Dialogs.Dialog: Kobayakawa
Hey, what do you think "going out" really means？
Huh？ Did something happen？
Nothing much, just talking with some friends. I wanted to hear what my boyfriend thinks, too.
Let's see... How about both people wanting to be together forever？
Not bad, I guess, though it's hardly surprising.
It doesn't need to be surprising. What do you think, ▲小早川＊▲？
Who knows. Apparently, if a couple's out of sync on this, they won't work out.
Huh, I see. So, are we out of sync？
I thought we were doing pretty well together, though？
Haha, of course we are!
Right. So there's your answer. Good for us.
▲小早川＊▲？ Lost in thought？
Kobayakawa
...Nothing gets past you. I was just remembering something a friend asked me.
About what it really means to go out with someone.
That's a tough one... So what did you say, ▲小早川＊▲？
I couldn't come up with an answer.
Why？
Because everyone else was saying stuff like "it's a hassle" or "it's just being tied down"...
I don't dislike those girls or anything. Still, I thought it was kind of sad to look at it that way.
Quit looking so worried. I don't feel that way at all. Being with you... is fun, you know？
Kobayakawa
Hey, can I ask you a question？
What is it？ You sound serious.
What does it really mean to go out with someone？
？ Did I do something to make you uneasy？
It's not that. A friend came to me for advice, and I couldn't give her a good answer.
That's easy. It means being a couple. Isn't it as simple as that？
Well, that's a casual answer. And here I was overthinking all kinds of complicated stuff.
My bad!
Well, I guess being so carefree is one of your good points. Makes me feel silly for worrying over it. We're a couple! Simple as that, right？
Yeah!
You've been spacing out for a while now. What's up？
Kobayakawa
...Just thinking.
If you're worried about something, I'm here to listen, you know？
Jumping straight from "thinking" to "worried" is pretty simplistic of you.
Okay, if you're not worried, then what is it？
I didn't say I wasn't worried.
Make up your mind!
Honestly, a girl's heart is complicated.
(A girl's heart... What even goes on in a girl's head...？)
Kobayakawa
Hey, can you ever tell what I'm thinking？
Well, better than I used to...
Oh yeah？ Then what was I thinking just now？
Huh, right now？ Hmm... I-it's itchy behind your ear？
...Did I get it right？
Hah...
Ugh... Oh, I know what you're thinking right now.
Let's hear it？
...That I'm an idiot？
Correct.
(I still have a long way to go...)
What goes on inside a girl's head, anyway？
Kobayakawa
Did something happen？
Some girls in class were laughing their heads off, and when I asked why, even they didn't know.
Yeah, I get it, I get it.
Are you like that too, ▲小早川＊▲？ Hmm...
That's not it. Saying I "get it" means I understand the phenomenon, not that I relate to them, okay？
Uh... Meaning？
Basically, they aren't thinking at all. Girls cry for complicated reasons, but laugh for no reason. That's my theory.
Huh. So you're not like that, ▲小早川＊▲.
Yep. My emotions are complex, so do your best to unravel them♪
(Hmm, I wish she'd just show me the answer key...)
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲... What kind of thing makes your heart race？
Kobayakawa
Why are you asking that？ Seems kind of suspicious.
It's not suspicious. Making his girlfriend's heart race is part of a boyfriend's job, right？
Where did you get that line？
A friend said it. Got it secondhand from a magazine.
I figured as much. It's so like you to just flat-out ask the girl herself.
Yeah...
Well, whatever. My heart races when I'm out walking alone at night, I guess.
That's not what I meant! Besides, it's dangerous alone!
Exactly. Thinking some nosy old man might talk to me again reminds me of before we dated. Makes my heart race.
When does your heart race, ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
Like I'd tell you that easily. I know you'll just use it on me.
Well, that's why I'm asking.
See？ I'm not about to help out the enemy. Besides, shouldn't you be the one to go first？
Me？ For me... let's see...
Come on, out with it!
Number one is when I kiss you, ▲小早川＊▲!
Uh, should I be more specific？
Idiot! I don't need that!
(So saying stuff like that makes ▲小早川＊▲'s heart race, huh...)
Kobayakawa
Hey, can I ask you something？
What？
Did your heart race when you first met me？
...I think so. Though maybe it was excitement more than my heart racing.
Really？
Yeah. Back then, I never imagined you and I would end up like this, ▲小早川＊▲.
Heh, I think I saw it coming before you did. Every time we met, you made my heart race a little more.
Made your heart race, huh... Does it still do that more and more even now？
Oh, too bad. You got carried away just now, so that's minus 10 points.
(...Points for what, exactly？)
Kobayakawa
Hey, which do you handle worse: being in a pinch, or having a big chance？
Hmm, obviously I hate being in a pinch... but a big chance means you can't afford to fail.
Right？ Either way your heart's pounding, so neither is much fun. Normal really is best.
True. As long as I can just be with you like usual, ▲小早川＊▲, that's enough for me.
That's a bit of a stretch.
Still, it's true, isn't it？
Well, maybe. Still, if we stay together a long time, I'm sure we'll hit all kinds of pinches and chances.
Like what？
Like, our future together... and stuff like that!
Kobayakawa
Do you know that romance drama that's really popular lately？
Yeah, the girls in my class won't stop talking about it.
They say the lead actor's voice is huge right now. Just hearing it makes your heart race.
What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
I don't know. Wanna try doing it for me？
Huh？ Like an impression？
Yeah. "The reason I came to this country was to meet you." Okay, go ahead!
Wait, you seriously want me to say that？
Yes！
"The reason I came to Towano City was to meet you, ▲小早川＊▲."
Well？ Did that make your heart race？
...That was a sneak attack!
Kobayakawa
Hey... thank you for always thinking about me.
Huh？ Why so formal all of a sudden？
Why are you that surprised？
Of course I'm surprised. That sounded like the final episode of something.
Like I'm about to go back to the future or something？
Yeah, just like that.
If it surprised you that much, then it worked. I saw a magazine ad that said, "Make your boyfriend's heart race once in a while!"
...I think that's the wrong kind of heart-racing.
Really？
(It definitely is...)
Is there something on my face？
Kobayakawa
...Yeah, I really don't think you've changed.
I haven't changed？ Me？
My friend was saying... that you've gotten cooler lately.
People are saying that about me？
Wipe that grin off your face. Does it really make you that happy？
Well yeah, of course it does.
Well, whatever. Just don't let it go to your head. ...So, any idea what caused it？
If I've changed, it's probably because of you, ▲小早川＊▲. Nothing else comes to mind.
Eh？
...I like the sound of that. Hehe, I don't think that's bad at all.
Kobayakawa
The other day, you were having an awfully fun chat with some girl, weren't you？
Was I？ ...Maybe a girl from my class？
...Hmm. Well, whatever.
Wait... are you jealous？
...I was just checking, that's all.
Sorry, sorry, I get it. Don't give me such a scary look.
I feel like there've been a lot of girls around you lately.
Hmm... True, ever since I started dating you, ▲小早川＊▲, maybe I've gotten better at talking to girls.
What？ Hold on, you just said that so casually.
Guess that's the confidence of a guy with a cute girlfriend!
Confidence... Put yourself in my shoes, will you!
Kobayakawa
Were you browsing magazines at the convenience store the other day？
...Yeah, I think I was. What gives？ You should've said hi.
Thought that was you.
You couldn't tell？
You just looked a little bigger than usual.
Wonder if I gained weight.
That's not what I mean. More dependable, I guess... Way different from when you were looking around holding a can of mackerel...
...Don't make me say embarrassing stuff.
How's that my fault？
I can't let you go to the convenience store alone at night anymore.
(Never thought I'd hear that from ▲小早川＊▲...)
Kobayakawa
Were you peeking into my classroom the other day？
I just came to check on you, ▲小早川＊▲.
I knew it. You should've called out to me.
You were having fun eating lunch with your friends, so I held back.
Why？ Don't hold back around me.
Not you, ▲小早川＊▲—your friends. You looked like the center of the group, ▲小早川＊▲, so I'd feel bad pulling you away, right？
Me, the center of the group...？ I don't think so.
...Though when the topic turns to romance, everyone does tend to bombard me with questions.
(So that's why they were staring at me too...)
Kobayakawa
Hey... someone asked me for relationship advice.
They asked you, ▲小早川＊▲？
Yeah. Got a problem with that？
No, I was just thinking, what a change.
In me？ You think so...？
Not you, ▲小早川＊▲. Your friends.
...Well, maybe.
So, what kind of advice did they ask for？
Tips on how to make things work with an older boyfriend.
Whoa... And what'd you tell them？
I'm not spoiling that for you.
(...Now I'm curious.)
Kobayakawa
When I went by your class the other day, someone called me your 'child bride'...
...Sorry you had to put up with that.
I don't really care. You're only a year older. Boys really are childish.
Yeah. Before I knew it, everyone in my class knew about you and me, ▲小早川＊▲.
So we're an official couple？ ...I don't mind that.
Still, if they tease you too much, I'll...
It's fine. Actually, since I'm your girlfriend, they seem to look out for me. They even go out of their way to tell me stuff like, 'He just left with a girl.'
...Oh, really.
Guess you can't do anything bad now, huh？
No way am I doing that！
Kobayakawa
Did you see that couple earlier？ The girl had full makeup on.
Yeah, she really stood out.
Yeah, I couldn't help staring a little too. I guess couples around our age always catch my eye.
Is that how it is？
Isn't it？ Like comparing them to ourselves.
No need to compare. I prefer you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Eh？
What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
I feel the same way...
Whoa, that's honest of you. What's the occasion？
Actually, that was a lie. Forget I said anything.
(...I take that back.)
Kobayakawa
That old couple earlier... They seemed really close.
...Yeah, holding hands at that age is pretty nice, isn't it？
Yeah. Feels like they've got us beat.
For now, yeah. We'll get there with time, too. Right, Grandma？
That's right, Grandpa.
For a second there, I actually pictured you as an old man.
How was it？ How'd I look as an old man？
A pretty handsome silver fox. Though maybe I'm biased.
I see. I bet you'll make a cute old lady too, ▲小早川＊▲.
I hope we can stay together forever.
Kobayakawa
That couple just now... Whoa. I didn't know where to look.
They were high schoolers, right？
...Yeah. Compared to them, we're pretty tame, huh.
That's a bad comparison. They're what you call idiots in love.
That's probably true.
Though if you want to, ▲小早川＊▲, I don't mind...
Well, it's not like I'd hate it...
You wouldn't！？
...Never mind, I would.
I was just thinking back to your texts from when we first met, ▲小早川＊▲—
Kobayakawa
Forget about those already.
Why？ Those are precious memories for us. Don't you remember them, ▲小早川＊▲？
...It's not like I forgot.
See？ Makes me realize we've been dating for quite a while now.
Alright, I get it already.
Like back in the beginning, for example...
That's enough. Why do you have to be so childish...？ Even after all this time, you're still an old man who acts like a kid.
Kobayakawa
What gets closer the longer it goes on？
A riddle？
Yeah. A friend told me her boyfriend asked her that.
Hmm... I give up. What's the answer？
The bond between a guy and a girl. What about us？ We've been dating a while now.
Well, forget just being close— I'm fine with zero distance between us.
...I see. Then what feels deeper the closer you get？
Huh, part two？
Yeah. There's a follow-up.
The rift between a guy and a girl. Meaning you need to keep the right distance.
(Duly noted...)
Our texts have really piled up, huh. Guess that shows how long we've been dating.
Kobayakawa
...Yeah. When you read them back, doesn't it bring back memories of those times？
Like when we went on dates, or what we ate...
Yeah. Plus... the times we had misunderstandings, too.
...Yeah, I guess so？ ...Sorry about those.
You don't need to apologize.
I'd never really felt like we've been together a long time, but... I think I kinda felt it just now.
Yeah, same here. To say it like you would, ▲小早川＊▲... I guess it's "not bad."
Hehe, that actually means "the best." Did you know that？
